plugin_description: Abandon hope, all ye software engineers who enter here. Mod added forms have a "deals" prefix, Bethesda modified forms are listed in deals___editedlist along with how they were changed, but it hasn't been updated since 3.0
extraction: Direct Bethesda TES5 plugin record parsing, including zlib-compressed records and extended-size subrecords. Text-bearing records are retained with FormID and mod-added/override provenance. Papyrus source is scanned separately for runtime string literals.
known_gaps: Dialogue speaker attribution is not fully normalized; INFO conditions are retained for later resolution.
Two compiled Papyrus scripts do not have matching source files; their printable strings are retained, but no full decompilation was attempted.
Meshes, textures, audio, and other non-text assets were intentionally not copied into the lore continuity.

Papyrus source files were scanned during ingestion, but complete source bodies and per-file archive member paths/hashes were not persisted in this continuity; promoted script evidence is therefore filename-level until the original archive or a persisted source copy is available for byte/line revalidation.

canonical_import_format.source_records: 29 gzip-compressed UTF-8 JSONL shards under source-records/ containing every decoded non-EDID text-bearing plugin record; EDID retained as record identity.
canonical_import_format.indexes: Books, dialogue topics, quests, actors, factions, cells, worlds, and scenes.
canonical_import_format.papyrus: Extracted Papyrus source string-literal inventory plus printable strings from the two compiled-only PEX files. Full PSC bodies were scanned during ingestion but are not currently persisted in this continuity.
canonical_import_format.evidence_locator_index: indexes/evidence-locator-index.jsonl tracks promoted script/message evidence locator precision, source-container provenance, and revalidation status.
